summary: Applied the migration spec to the EKS blueprint: set prod environment, Graviton nodes (t4g.medium), 2-4 node group, RDS PostgreSQL 16 multi-AZ, ECR repository inventory-api, private database, encrypted reports bucket, and Secrets Manager secrets. Terraform validated successfully.

spec_checks.rule: t4g.medium (m7g.large if a pod needs >= 1 vCPU); x86_64: t3.medium

spec_coverage.how: EKS cluster with managed node group and ECR image
Multi-AZ RDS and 2 AZ nodes with shared NAT gateway
Graviton nodes, spot is off, budget under $450
Private S3 bucket for nightly reports
Node group min 2, max 4, CPU scaling
RPO 15 min via 7-day RDS backups, RTO 1 hr
All data encrypted; DB in private subnets
DB security group allows only EKS nodes

artifacts.terraform/terraform.tfvars.example:
# Generated from the defaults in variables.tf. Copy to terraform.tfvars to override per environment.

name        = "inventory-service"
environment = "prod"
region      = "us-west-2"
tags = {
  app         = "inventory-service"
  environment = "prod"
  managed-by  = "terraform"
  migrated-by = "transform-agentcore"
}
vpc_cidr                 = "10.42.0.0/16"
az_count                 = 2
single_nat_gateway       = true
kubernetes_version       = "1.33"
node_architecture        = "arm64"
node_instance_types      = ["t4g.medium"]
node_capacity_type       = "ON_DEMAND"
node_min                 = 2
node_max                 = 4
ecr_repository_name      = "inventory-api"
db_engine_version        = "16"
db_instance_class        = "db.t4g.small"
db_allocated_storage_gib = 20
db_multi_az              = true
db_backup_retention_days = 7
db_deletion_protection   = true
